en: Amos 5

p.src: 1  Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:

ja: よ、私があなたがたのために歌うこの
en: Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:
u.src: 1  Listen to this word which I take up for a lamentation over you, O house of Israel:

p.src: 2  “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”

ja: に投げ倒され、 彼女を
en: “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”
u.src: 2  “The virgin of Israel has fallen; She shall rise no more. She is cast down on her land; there is no one to raise her up.”

p.src: 3  For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”

ja: われる。 「千人を出陣させた町には百人しか残らず、 百人を出陣させた町には十人しか残らない。 イスラエルの
en: For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”
u.src: 3  For the Lord GOD says: “The city that went out a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went out one hundred shall have ten left to the house of Israel.”

p.src: 4  For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

en: For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;
u.src: 4  For the LORD says to the house of Israel: “Seek me, and you will live;

p.src: 5  but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

ja: めるな。 ギルガルに
るな。 ベエル・シェバへ
って行くな。 ギルガルは
囚となり、 ベテルは
en: but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.
u.src: 5  but don’t seek Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and don’t pass to Beersheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nothing.

p.src: 6  Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.

ja: めて生きよ。 そうでなければ、
は火のようにヨセフの
に燃え広がり、 これを
くす。 ベテルには、その火を
en: Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.
u.src: 6  Seek the LORD, and you will live, lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and it devour, and there be no one to quench it in Bethel.

p.src: 7  You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

en: You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!
u.src: 7  You who turn justice to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth!

p.src: 8  Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,

ja: すばるとオリオン座を
en: Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,
u.src: 8  Seek him who made the Pleiades and Orion, and turns the shadow of death into the morning, and makes the day dark with night; who calls for the waters of the sea, and pours them out on the surface of the earth, the LORD is his name,

p.src: 9  who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

en: who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.
u.src: 9  who brings sudden destruction on the strong, so that destruction comes on the fortress.

p.src: 10  They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

en: They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.
u.src: 10  They hate him who reproves in the gate, and they abhor him who speaks blamelessly.

p.src: 11  Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

ja: てている。 それゆえ、
えても、 そのぶどう
en: Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.
u.src: 11  Therefore, because you trample on the poor and take taxes from him of wheat, you have built houses of cut stone, but you will not dwell in them. You have planted pleasant vineyards, but you shall not drink their wine.

p.src: 12  For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.

ja: っている。 あなたがたは義人を
en: For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.
u.src: 12  For I know how many are your offenses, and how great are your sins— you who afflict the just, who take a bribe, and who turn away the needy in the courts.

p.src: 13  Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

en: Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.
u.src: 13  Therefore a prudent person keeps silent in such a time, for it is an evil time.

p.src: 14  Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

ja: めよ。悪を求めるな。 そうすれば、あなたがたは生きる。 あなたがたが
があなたがたとともにおられる。
en: Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.
u.src: 14  Seek good, and not evil, that you may live; and so the LORD, the God of Armies, will be with you, as you say.

p.src: 15  Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

ja: をあわれまれるかもしれない。」
en: Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”
u.src: 15  Hate evil, love good, and establish justice in the courts. It may be that the LORD, the God of Armies, will be gracious to the remnant of Joseph.”

p.src: 16  Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.

ja: きの声が上がり、 すべての
en: Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.
u.src: 16  Therefore the LORD, the God of Armies, the Lord, says: “Wailing will be in all the wide ways. They will say in all the streets, ‘Alas! Alas!’ They will call the farmer to mourning, and those who are skillful in lamentation to wailing.

p.src: 17  In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.

ja: が上がる。 私があなたがたのただ
en: In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.
u.src: 17  In all vineyards there will be wailing, for I will pass through the middle of you,” says the LORD.

p.src: 18  “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.

ja: いあれ。 なぜあなたがたは
en: “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.
u.src: 18  “Woe to you who desire the day of the LORD! Why do you long for the day of the LORD? It is darkness, and not light.

p.src: 19  As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

ja: にかまれるようなものだ。
en: As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.
u.src: 19  As if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or he went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a snake bit him.

p.src: 20  Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

ja: ではないのではないか。
きは少しもないのではないか。
en: Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?
u.src: 20  Won’t the day of the LORD be darkness, and not light? Even very dark, and no brightness in it?

p.src: 21  I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

ja: み、忌み嫌う。 あなたがたの
en: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.
u.src: 21  I hate, I despise your feasts, and I can’t stand your solemn assemblies.

p.src: 22  Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

ja: げても、 私はそれらを
en: Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.
u.src: 22  Yes, though you offer me your burnt offerings and meal offerings, I will not accept them; neither will I regard the peace offerings of your fat animals.

p.src: 23  Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

ja: がしい音を、 私から遠ざけよ。 あなたがたの竪
en: Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.
u.src: 23  Take away from me the noise of your songs! I will not listen to the music of your harps.

p.src: 24  But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

en: But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.
u.src: 24  But let justice roll on like rivers, and righteousness like a mighty stream.

p.src: 25  “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

en: “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?
u.src: 25  “Did you bring to me sacrifices and offerings in the wilderness forty years, house of Israel?

p.src: 26  You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

ja: あなたがたは、自分たちの王の天幕と、偶像を載せる台座と、
en: You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.
u.src: 26  You also carried the tent of your king and the shrine of your images, the star of your god, which you made for yourselves.

p.src: 27  Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.

ja: それゆえ、私はあなたがたをダマスコのかなたへ
en: Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.
u.src: 27  Therefore I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus,” says the LORD, whose name is the God of Armies.
